name: ergoCub
summary: An evolution of iCub, developed by IIT with INAIL, focused on physical collaboration and workplace ergonomics: ergoCub can lift and hand over payloads while estimating the strain a co-working human is under, to research reducing musculoskeletal injuries. Hardware and software remain open like iCub's.
notable: Adds human-strain estimation for ergonomic collaboration

sources.title: IIT AMI — ergoCub for physical human-robot interaction
